title: Demon Lotus against the Double-headed Demon Dog
summary: Powered by the Jiuyou Bird, Mu Chen forges a fourth Senluo Death Mark and breaks Liu Jingshan's Mountain God Art, but she warns the borrowed Heavenly Fusion power will tear his body apart if the fight drags on. Liu Jingshan summons the spirit of his Double-headed Demon Dog, 98th on the Earth list of beasts, and fuses with it at the cost of his own cultivation. Using the Heart Formation state to dodge while laying seals, Mu Chen completes the Level 3 Demon Lotus Spirit-Slaying Formation. It overcomes Liu Jingshan's Black Dragon Wind and Fire Execution, and when the old man tries to flee Mu Chen kills him. The lords marvel that Mu Realm has such a trump card, and Mu Chen collapses at his limit.
events: Mu Chen forges extra Senluo Death Marks and breaks the Land Subduing Mountain.
Liu Jingshan says Mu Chen's own power is only late Spiritual Rotation and tries to outlast the borrowed power.
Liu Jingshan summons the Double-headed Demon Dog's spirit, then fuses body and spirit.
Mu Chen dodges in the Heart Formation state while forging seals, as he did in an earlier fight.
The Demon Lotus Spirit-Slaying Formation is activated.
Liu Jingshan's Black Dragon Wind and Fire Execution fails; he tries to escape and is killed.
The lords acknowledge Mu Feng's son; Mu Chen is at his physical limit.
introduced: Black Dragon Wind and Fire Execution
cultivation: Mu Chen's own realm is Spiritual Rotation, Late Phase; the Jiuyou Bird's power lifts him to Heavenly Fusion only temporarily. Liu Jingshan (Heavenly Fusion) dies.
